notes: Play knowledge rewritten as executable actions. Every reference is checked against the generated level data by tools/gen_level_nuance.py.

Egypt is the game's last bonus level and breaks the rules the rest of the game teaches: the floor is hostile, the objective is a trap, and the boss appears to die repeatedly without dying. A bot trained on the campaign will read every one of those signals wrong.

nuance.claim: Tiles in the gun room trigger drone guns when stepped on, so the floor itself is a hazard and open ground cannot be treated as safe.
A specific route across the tiles reaches the gun without triggering anything, so the room is a path-finding problem rather than a fight to survive.
The drone guns that emerge from the tiles cannot be destroyed, so once triggered the only answer is to leave their line of fire rather than fight them.
Picking up the gun raises glass around the pedestal and brings out several guns at once, so the escape route matters more than the approach did.
The golden gun is recovered before the confrontation, both because it is the earlier objective and because it is the weapon that makes the confrontation short.
nuance.because: The level has exactly two objectives and the confrontation is the terminal one.

nuance.claim: The recovered gun kills in a single hit, which is why the objective order is worth respecting rather than rushing the boss with a carried weapon.
The boss appears in several places and drops without dying; a kill that is followed by laughter was an impostor and the objective has not advanced.
The real encounter does not become available until the impostors have been dealt with, so the repeated fights are a prerequisite rather than a distraction.
The sky darkening is the game's signal that the impostors are done and the real encounter is now reachable, which is the only cue given.
The final room is reached through a concealed door back in the room where the boss was first seen, so the route doubles back rather than continuing forward.
The passage to the final room is covered by emplaced guns, so the last stretch is run under fire and cannot be cleared first.
